title: Feature test: earshot effects, Real-ESRGAN, parallax

paragraphs.text: This is a short test of three new tools. First, a map flight across the Netherlands, with designed sound effects under every move. Then a small archive photo from 1916, enlarged four times. Then full-frame photos that move in depth.
Here is another one, a canal in Amsterdam, and then the windmills of the Zaanse Schans, each with a slow camera move that shows near and far apart.
